# Problem 1 

## Load Packages

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
data("penguins", package = "palmerpenguins")
```

## Description of Penguins Data set 

Write a short description of the penguins dataset (not the penguins_raw dataset) using inline R code. In your discussion, please include:

the data in this dataset, including names / values of important variables
the size of the dataset (using nrow and ncol)
the mean flipper length

The data in this dataset describes different species of penguins across different islands. The 

This data set has `r nrow (penguins)` rows and `r ncol(penguins)` columns.

The mean flipper length is `r mean(pull(penguins, flipper_length_mm), na.rm = TRUE)`mm.

## Scatterplot 

```{r warning = F}
ggplot(data = penguins,
       mapping = aes(bill_length_mm, flipper_length_mm, color = species)) + geom_point()

ggsave("scatterplot.png")
```
